title: The Quiet Crown's final arena
story_basis: docs/full-story.md section10: connected Stillmere arenas; phase1 wooden village copies and repeating platforms; phase2 orchard/fen reflections/gorge bells; phase3 First Lantern/Stillfall, roots freezing patterns; four points activated for new connection.
Crown creature/forms/guardian attacks are separate assets. Arena structures, node geometry and visual staging below are production interpretations; no destructive violent ending.
review_notes: Environment proposal/prototype; no production approval or runtime integration inferred.
Interactive art states below are production interpretations, not newly established story mechanics.

Only eight base images generated. Phase-one Stillmere palette anchors the pictured layers. Phase-two orchard/fen/gorge and phase-three First Lantern/Stillfall palette constraints are documented continuity guidance; separate phase backgrounds are not delivered.

Eight requested source types saved and visually reviewed as generated prototypes; no final production approval. Terrain module edge matching and collision setup, prop pivots and FX timing remain cleanup work.

deliverables.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Lanterns Underroot hand-painted illustrated 2D side-scrolling platformer asset. Input images ART-001/002/006 are style, palette, material and layer-separation references ONLY; ignore their text, logos, characters, guide panels and layouts. Match rich painterly wood/stone/foliage, selective crisp silhouettes, restrained brush texture, warm amber light against forest greens and cool blue-teal shadows. Strict SIDE-ON game camera, no isometric view or forced vanishing-point perspective on usable surfaces. No player, NPC, enemy, UI, logo, watermark, labels or text. Deliver one named usable asset type only; never a concept board or flattened multi-layer scene posing as separate game layers. Quiet Crown final arena within Stillmere: preserve memories while opening connections, not royal throne room. Base arena phase1 repeating wooden village echoes; later orchard/fen/bell fragments and First Lantern confrontation. No Crown character or NPC copies baked into layers. Primary request: ONE 1536x1024 composed side-on environment LIGHTING STUDY of The Quiet Crown's final arena. Phase-one cool blue-black still-sky shadows and amber village echoes; phase-two muted green/teal/bronze memory accents; phase-three darker roots with First Lantern amber focus; resolution warms gradually. Reference only, not runtime atlas. Show one coherent representative location view without characters; no panels, guide text, logos or atlas. It may combine environment layers solely to demonstrate intended light/depth. This is explicitly an art reference, NOT a runtime layer, terrain atlas, flattened substitute for the other seven deliverables, or production-ready level. Use the phase-one Stillmere arena as the single pictured view. The later phase palettes are continuity guidance, not an instruction to combine three battlefield scenes into one image; later-phase lighting studies may be prepared separately.
review_notes: Recovered completed generation after interruption; visual review follows. Reference only, not runtime layer.
